method.population: cross-source candidate pairs proposed by blocking rule camera_geo_grid over the hosted spine's 230,330 observation-level camera records with a coordinate pair (read-only pull 2026-09-24T06:3xZ), assessed by camera_site_rules.toml v1
method.sampling: stratified by (tier, stratum) with seed 30: 120 tier-1g, 120 tier-3g, 60 tier-4g, 60 tier-5g pairs, round-robin across strata cross_source_mirror / dense_urban (either record has >=3 other records within 50 m) / highway_corridor (highway road/name) / rural_singleton (both records have <=1 other record within 100 m) / other; small strata are oversampled (conservative for precision)
method.adjudication: double, blind to the matcher's tier: (1) the agent/maintainer seed (the verifier; the frozen holdout's label), labelled from the evidence sheet; (2) an LLM adjudicator run in a fresh context that saw ONLY the written adjudication_rules (camera_site_rules.toml) and the same evidence sheet
method.holdout: 30% of pairs frozen with seed 30 (resolution.gold_set._freeze_holdout); the holdout label is the verifier's
method.snapshot: attributes and distances only — no coordinates are stored (SIG-GEO-009 / §19.4)
method.v2_holdout: a FRESH sample never seen during rule development: 180 pairs disjoint from camera-1, drawn with seed 302 from the rules-v2 assessment of the same pull — 70 tier-1g, 70 tier-3g (auto-write-eligible: no soft conflict), 20 tier-4g, 20 tier-5g, round-robin across the same strata; ALL 180 are the frozen holdout, adjudicated blind (agent seed + a second fresh-context LLM run reading only the written rules and the sheet)
method.training: the 360 camera-1 pairs (retired from the holdout after inspection) are the training partition the v2 rules were derived from

history.outcome: both candidate tiers below the 0.98 floor -> nothing auto-writes under rules v1; the v1 holdout was then INSPECTED while diagnosing, so it was retired to training and rules v2 were measured on a fresh holdout (camera-2)
